title: Dexcom Clarity Uploader
body: When using upload to Dexcom servers it works with Dexcom Follow mobile app, but no data are visible in Clarity web app.

comments.body:
Hi, I'm facing the same issue, someone said there is 3 hours delay. I have been waiting more than 10 hours and still no data in Dexcom Clarity, in the mean time Dexcom Follow works fine. Have you fixed the problem?
Thanks

My problem still persists. 

Data definitely reached some dexcom server because it was distributed to Follow mobile app.

I would like to sniff http going out of official Dexcom App, but I haveit  only on iPhone and it is not easy there.

xdrip+ does not send data to Dexcom Clarity. As far as I know, there are no plans to include this functionality into xdrip+ for a variety of reasons.

As far as the three hours delay, that relates to the iPhone G5 Mobile App sending data to Apple Health, and has nothing to do with Clarity.

For me it is not problem as I use Nightwatch for storing and viewing my son's data.

But it is problem for our clinic. They are fixed to Diasend for all patients data.
Only way I know how to upload there is Clarity -> Diasend connect.
If someone know about other, I'm happy to investigate.
There is no way to upload data from xdrip+ or Nightwatch into Clarity or Diasend. You could use Nightscout instead, which has it's own full-featured reporting tool set.

As I said Nightwatch is great for me, but clinic requires Diasend.
It looks like it will need some coding. I have some spare time over holiday and will lookup my options.
I'll share with community if there is some outcome.

Hi. My project got stuck on licensing and legal problem. Dexcom has no public API for writing data to Clarity. Obviously, there is good API but locked for their own apps.
I have done reverse engineering and I have partially working uploader. But it is licensing breach if I'll make it public.
Dexcom is not communicating with me much. I expect that they have no interest in open source.
I'll keep trying while I finish uploader to beta stage.
Thank you for your time invested in this feature. It is very sad that Dexcom is not cooperating in this matter.

I noticed that the Diasend uploader application interfaces with a number of other meters.  Picking the freestyle Neo as an example I found some work already done on the interface format https://github.com/Flameeyes/glucometer-protocols/blob/master/abbott/freestyle-precision-neo.md

Can anyone see a possible way to upload to Diasend by emulating another device?  There seems to be a possibility of  creating a virtual HID device or maybe a solution as simple as uploading to one of the accepted meters and then uploading from the meter using the official application.

My aim is purely to keep my endo informed at the review meetings, for my own personal use nightscout is preferred.
This would be a big help for us also so I'd like to help with the development and testing.  Is there a branch out there I can look at?

@PatrikTrestik  - IANAL, but I'd be interested to hear why you think that your reverse engineered code would be a legal issue.  The DCMA has [reverse engineering exemptions](https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/blogs/techftc/2016/10/dmca-security-research-exemption-consumer-devices) for consumer devices, and that includes most medical devices.

As long as you've not signed an NDA with Dexcom you may be able to publish your findings.  If you're concerned about the specific code, you could always describe in more general terms your findings regarding the data format, any checksums, etc and some else could prepare a clean implementation.

+1 on upload to Diasend. @PatrikTrestik Would be great to hear about your workaround to Clarity 👍
 
Diasend/Glooko receives information from different kind of glucose meters, so by uploading xDrip+ data to a glucosemeter and then to Diasend might be a solution.

Hoping the Dexcom upload issue can be resolved.  Same as another commenter, my Endo uses Dexcom Clarity apps.  I like XDrip, but have to be about to get my reading to the doc.  May be able to find a workaround, but as of now, I'm having to go back to the Dexcom app.

This is not a bug. It's a feature request to support uploading to a manufacturers (dexcom) clarity web service. Dexcom explicitly allows only its own app to do this. To support this will require reverse engineering, and it's not an easy just-so-it kind of task.

Hi to all. I would like to resurrect this issue/project "How to upload data to Diasend/Clarity.
If you are still listening to this thread, please share your ideas and information about the current situation.
Hi, very interested in uploading from nightscout to Diasend - maybe Diasend could help, especially if they are told how many people are using nightscout around the world?
I started a new project, see status updates here https://github.com/PatrikTrestik/diasend-upload/
Thanks for your hard work. We are all waiting for this.

Please post/comment Diasend related stuff to #716. This issue requests Clarity uploads.

Because we try to improve our issue management to speed up development, it would be really helpful to have clearly focused and "clean" issues, comments included.
This is a valid feature request and should not be closed until someone made a final decision.
Because no public API is available, we are closing this issue for now.
